question: What subtle yogic sensation at the point of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: A point of nectar is indicated
There is contact with the tip of essence
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise may experience a burning sensation at the subtle point of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are yogically technical.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel a burning at the tip of nectar, at the point of essence.
